context: Reference coverage for sorted, limit, toSet, and partitioningBy stream patterns.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates ProductListTransforms.java with the requested methods and nested records.

checklist.name: Uses filter and sorted for favorites
checklist.description: Filters in-stock favorites and sorts with Comparator.comparing(Product::name).

checklist.name: Uses sorted then limit for top products
checklist.description: Sorts by rating descending before limit(3), avoiding subList after full materialization.

checklist.name: Uses toSet for unique codes
checklist.description: Maps orders to discount codes and collects directly to a set.

checklist.name: Uses partitioningBy for availability
checklist.description: Uses Collectors.partitioningBy(product -> product.stock() > 0) or equivalent boolean partition that returns both keys.
